translation.name: New Testament in the Yaka language (Congo-Brazzaville)

book.name: 2 Timoteo
book.title: Mukaanda a Pawuli wa mioolo kwaa Timoteo

content: Mabwee
Me Pawuli, wuli tumu a Yiisu Kristo, mu litoono la Nziaambi. Nziaambi asooli me mu uyaabisa moonyi wubalasini bisi mu Yiisu Kristo.
Me nitsinduu mukaanda wu kwaa Timoteo, mwaana a me wa litoono: Nyaala Nziaambi Taayi na Yiisu Kristo Pfumu a bisi baha we bweese, mbweeyili, na iyeenge!
Pawuli li mu uvutulu matoondo kwaa Nziaambi mundaa Timoteo
Me nivutulu matoondo kwaa Nziaambi, wu me ndi mu usalila mu matsimi matsieeme, weti bwasiiri bakaa ba me, mundaa ti me ndi mu uhama mu ukuundu mu we, butsuu na nyanga.
Me ndi mu ulibili moonyi mu matsanga ma we, mu taanga di diakikabuu. Me ndi na nzala yalaa ya ubwamono we, paa me uluulu mu kinyi.
Me ndi mu ulibili moonyo mu imiini kia ngwanya, ki we li na kio. Ni imiini kiali na kaa a we wa mukaasa Loyisi na nguu a we Enikia, tswaamini a we. Me ndi mu utsimi ti kio ili ka mu we.
Ni mu buu me ndi mu ulibili we moonyi mu yo: bwalulu mbaa ya bungori ba Nziaambi ahi kwaa we, mu taanga di me nanayi mioo nha yulu a we.
Mu ngwanya Muheebili wu Nziaambi ahi kwaa bisi, a ali mu uha bisi boomo pe, ka bunu Muheebili wuu li mu uluusu bisi mu mifuri, mu litoono, na mu kamini a mutimi.

Aba na tsionyi pe mu uta imbaangi mu Pfumu a bisi. Aba ka na tsionyi pe mu me, wuli mu perese mu ndaa nde. Ka siingi umono pasi na me mu ndaa Ndaa Yimbwe, mu usa ilimbisi mu mifuri mi Nziaambi ali mu uha.
Ni nde:

content.text: Wayobili bisi na wata bisi mu mbili ya ngiri.
A uli pe mu ndaa biyiluu bibibwe bi bisi diasi, nde ayilii buu,
ka mu ndaa minhana mia nde,
na mu bweese ba nde aheeri bisi.
Nde amweesi bisi bweese ba nde mu Yiisu Kristo, tswaamina a taanga didihele uwa.
Nde amweesi bisi bo mu taanga di,
mu nziriri a muvuyisi a bisi Yiisu Kristo.
Ni nde asukusu lituu la likwa,
na mu Ndaa Yimbwe, amweesi moonyi wu uhele ukwa.

content: Nziaambi abiaalisi me mu uyaabisa Ndaa Yimbwe yi, weti muyiisi na tumu a Yiisu Kristo.

Ni mu ndaa yii me ndi mu umono pasi di. Ka me a ndi na tsionyi pe, mundaa ti me nayaaba mu na me na sa imiini. Na, me ndi na ilimbisi ti, nde li na lituu la ukebe bii bi nde aha kwaa me, natee mu iluumbu kia pfuundisi.
Holo weti ifwaani mandaa masuungunu ma me nayaabisa we. Temene na ngwi mu imiini, na mu litoono li bisi dili na lo mu itwaari na Yiisu Kristo.
Kebe mandoongi mamabwe mabaheeri we, mu libaasila la Muheebili wa Ngira wuli mu udiaala mu bisi.
Pamini a Onesifora
Weti bu we ayaaba, boosi ba ku itinini kia Asia babwoongolo me, nha kati a bo uli na Pingela na Ermongena ka.
Nyaala Pfumu amweese mbweeyili a nde kwaa likaanda la Onesifora, mundaa ti nde ubaahamisanga me mu mataanga mama mosi. Nde a amoni tsionyi mu me pe, mu mikuru mia me pe.
Ka mu diina taanga di nde atoori ku ngaanda a Looma, nde asiayi me mu nzala yalaa, natee bu nde asiolili me.
Nyaala Pfumu aha nde bweese ba Nziaambi mu iluumbu kia pfuundisi! We ayiluu uyaaba ka libaasila li nde ahi kwaa me bu nali ku ngaanda a Efeso.
